identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study for Older Adults With Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Study for Older Adults With Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The NCRI Adult ALL sub-group propose to collaborate with the Dutch/Belgian group HOVON to carry out a prospective, non randomised multi-arm study (including a choice of regimen intensity) to investigate the safety, tolerability and feasibility of a standardised therapy protocol for patients ≥ 60 years old with de novo ALL. The overall aim is define a basic standard of care upon which trials of novel therapies will be based in future. The design of the study will enable collection of a comprehensive dataset regarding the clinical outcome, Complete Response Rate (CR) and Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) response rates in a previously completely uncharacterised population, thus providing the essential platform for designing future randomised advanced phase studies in which new therapeutic approaches and novel therapies can be prospectively investigated.

armGroups.label: Philadelphia Positive Patients
armGroups.description: All patients with Philadelphia positive ALL will be treated in this group and will receive a standard imatinib-containing chemotherapy regimen

armGroups.label: Philadelphia -ve Patients- Intensive
armGroups.description: Patients with Philadelphia negative ALL who are fit for intensive treatment will be allocated into this group.

armGroups.label: Philadelphia -ve Patients- Intensive +
armGroups.description: Patients with Philadelphia negative disease and who are fit for intensive treatment will be entered into this group

armGroups.label: Philadelphia -ve Patients- Non Intensive
armGroups.description: Patients with Philadelphia negative disease who are not fit for intensive chemotherapy will be entered into this group

armGroups.label: Registration only
armGroups.description: Patients with either Philadelphia positive or negative ALL who do not wish to enter the study will be allocated to this group for data collection purposes only.

interventions.name: Chemotherapy
interventions.description: Treatment for all pathways consists of Induction, Intensification (where applicable), Consolidation and Maintenance therapy during which combination chemotherapy is given for up to 2.5 years.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Complete remission rate after 2 phases of induction
primaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be assessed for their remission status at the end of Phase 2 induction. The CR rate at this timepoint will then be calculated.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Approximately 2 months after start of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Complete remission rate after 1 phase of induction
secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be assessed for their remission status at the end of Phase 1 induction. The CR rate at this timepoint will then be calculated.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Approximately 1 month after start of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival for all patients will be measured 1 year after registration

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Prognostic significance of molecularly determined minimal residual disease (MRD) at various time-points during therapy with respect to relapse occurrence.
secondaryOutcomes.description: MRD levels will be measured at distinct timepoints during the trial.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At diagnosis, 4 weeks, 8 weeks, 12 weeks after starting treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Tolerability of treatment as determined by occurrence of key adverse effects
secondaryOutcomes.description: Patients in arms A-D will be assessed for adverse events at distinct timepoints during the trial
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Approximately 4 weeks, 8 weeks, 12 weeks, 24 weeks after starting treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be assessed for the number of days they have spent as in-patients at distinct timepoints during the trial.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Approximately 4 weeks, 8 weeks, 12 weeks, 24 weeks, 28 after starting treatment and every 3 months during maintenance

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Relationship between performance status/co-morbidity and treatment option chosen
Quality of life aspects assessed at diagnosis/baseline at various time points
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Registration, Approximately 4 weeks, 8 weeks, 12 weeks, 24 weeks, 28 after starting treatment, before starting maintenance and at the end of maintenance

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 60 with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ALL) OR ≥ 55 with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ALL) unsuitable for the UKALL14 or HOVON 100 trial
* Newly diagnosed, previously untreated ALL (a steroid pre-phase of 5-7 days may be given before trial registration))
* Willing and able to give consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known HIV infection
* Blast transformation of CML
* Mature B-cell leukaemia i.e. Burkitts disease t(8,14)(q24 ;q32) and variant c-myc translocations e.g. t(2;8)(p12 ;q24), t(8;22)(q24;q11)
* Women who are pregnant or lactating
